01	Ingredients:
Water, Sugar, Tomato Paste, Salt, Vegetable Thickener,
Mustard, Herbs and Spices, Acid Regulator, Natural Flavor
Smoke, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate as Preservative,
Natural Color Caramel IV (contain sulphite as preservative).

02	INGREDIENTS: Water, milk (fresh milk (20%), full cream milk
powder, milk solid, skimmed milk powder) 30%, sugar, cocoa powder
(1 %), stabilizer (vegetable base, trisodium citrate), vitamin premix,
almond powder (0.01%), synthetic flavor.

03	INGREDIENTS:
Water, skim & full cream milk powder (9 02%),
calcium caseinate, cocoa powder, whey protein
concentrate, stabilizer, synthetic flavor, emulsifier,
NaCI, L-carnitine, vitamin and mineral premix,
artificial sweetener sucralose, vitamin D (contain
antioxidant tocopheroi).

04	INGREDIENTS: Vilater, Sugar, Green Tea (3.95%), Honey
(0. 2%), Antioxidant (Vitamin C), Synthetic Honey Flavor.

05	Ingredients: Cocoa Powder, Synthetic
Flavour,
Manufactured on Shared Equipment that
Processes Peanuts, Tree Nuts, Milk, Soy
and Wheat.
